_about: Embedded pictures the website shows blurred (display only; Legacy itself is never edited). Keyed by the picture's build key: the first 14 characters of the SHA-1 of its bytes. "blur" is a percentage: 100 blurs by 6% of the picture's longer side, so 50 blurs by 3%. Each entry says where the picture is and why. The two pictures first listed here (Arc #2 and Arc #3 story notes, issue #79) are now blurred in Legacy itself, at the author's request ("Bypass due to content mod"), so they are no longer listed.
